current_evidence: The Broads Authority planning-permission page describes Checklist 1 as the national requirements and Checklist 2 as the additional reports and surveys; Checklist 2 is titled 'Additional local requirements' and says 'last reviewed 01/08/2024'.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link points to Validation Checklist 1. That page covers only the national requirements, not the Broads local list. The local list is Validation Checklist 2. The link does load (last reviewed 03/04/2025), so Grokbot's 'not readable: blocked/404/login' status is also wrong.
issues.evidence: Checklist 1: 'National requirements for validating a planning application'; Checklist 2: 'Additional local requirements that may be needed to validate a planning application'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no local requirements (0 items, all app types '(none)'). Checklist 2 contains about 40 local requirements. Key ones and their triggers: DM13 biodiversity enhancement statement (all development); biodiversity survey (agricultural building conversions; householder or minor development within 100m of a pond or waterbody; all bridge structures); DM9 climate change checklist (new build, replacement, change of use); DM14 energy demand reduction statement (all development; renewables statement for >10 dwellings or >1,000 sq m); DM16 landscape statement (all development); DM8 green infrastructure statement (all development); DM45 healthy places statement (new housing, commercial and recreational development); DM46 water safety plan (proposals increasing water access, or new quay heading or raised levels); DM4 water efficiency statement (all new, replacement or converted dwellings and non-residential buildings; BREEAM Water Calculator for non-residential); DM10 peat soils statement (development on peat); DM17 land raising and DM18 excavated material statements; DM22 lighting justification (Dark Sky Zone Category 1); DM32 riverbank stabilisation and DM33 mooring checklists; DM37 residential moorings management plan; DM38 rural workers' dwellings evidence; DM44 visitor and community facilities statement; DM7 open space statements; DM48 conversions statement; FRA (Flood Zones 2 and 3, >1ha in FZ1, critical drainage areas); heritage statement (always near a Scheduled Ancient Monument); D&AS (major, LBC, CA/WHS with 1+ dwelling or 100 sq m+); structural survey (conversion, rebuild, demolition); telecoms ICNIRP declaration; ventilation and extraction details (A3/A4/A5/B1/B2 uses); photographs and photomontages (demolition, or development affecting a CA or LB).
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist 2 sections: Biodiversity and Geodiversity; Energy; Health and Wellbeing; Water Efficiency; Moorings and Riverbanks; Soils and Engineering

issues.detail: The Planning page in Grokbot's reference row is http://www.broads-authority.gov.uk/broads-authority, a generic page. The relevant page is https://broads-authority.gov.uk/planning/planning-permission. Grokbot also records no list date. The current local list was last reviewed 01/08/2024.
issues.grok_comment: Agree the Planning page is generic and no date was recorded, but neither the saved copy nor the live Checklist 2 page shows a "Last reviewed 01/08/2024" date; only Checklist 1 shows a date (03/04/2025).
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The generic planning page and missing date stand; the "last reviewed 01/08/2024" date is withdrawn.

summary: Grokbot linked the national-only Checklist 1, not the Broads local list (Checklist 2, reviewed Aug 2024), and wrongly marked it unreadable. As a result none of the roughly 40 local requirements, many of them DM-policy statements required for all development, were captured.
